answer: Deposits are visible in reef, and echo reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 32% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 103 aliases, and each one needs its own funded falcon account. Scaling to 420 identities multiplies that fee by 378 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
